Moreover, we find that noise produces a kind of phase transition: for sufficiently high noise, a non-degenerate solution is not even optimal if parameter scales are limited (e.g., via regularization). These results extend recent analytic work on RNN representation learning and show that noise can act as a fundamental determinant of representations.
arxiv.titleZh: 含噪线性循环神经网络学习动态的理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察内在噪声是否只是干扰项，还是会实质塑造循环神经网络的表征学习。在一个线性激活、白噪声输入的解析可解模型中发现，噪声会强烈打破解空间的简并:在小权重初始化的 rich regime 下，噪声显著改变 read-in、readout 与循环权重之间的对齐方向。当噪声足够强时会出现相变——即便通过正则化限制参数尺度，非简并解也不再是最优解。结果把噪声确立为决定表征的基本因素，并扩展了近期关于 RNN 表征学习的解析工作。
arxiv.reason: RNN 学习动力学解析理论，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 关注方向关联弱

arxiv.title: A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame
arxiv.abstract: Interactive environments offer a practical way to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents, and competitive games extend this evaluation to decisions shaped by competing goals and other agents' choices. Yet existing evaluations confined to individual games or execution frameworks leave unclear which competitive advantages persist across settings. We introduce DECE (Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments), a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols. These games combine lasting strategic commitments, competition over shared resources, and multiple routes to victory. Our primary study evaluates 12 model-harness configurations, spanning nine models and four execution harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. The main and supplementary studies comprise 1,032 completed matches in total. These comparisons reveal broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths. Matched studies show that the same model can perform differently across execution harnesses, adding another source of variation to these profiles. These performance advantages do not consistently translate into better token or cost efficiency, making resource use an additional consideration when comparing configurations. Together, the findings support evaluating complete agent configurations by both their competitive performance across games and the resources needed to achieve it.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多种欧式桌游的 LLM 智能体统一竞技场
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 智能体评测多局限于单一游戏或单一执行框架，难以判断其竞争优势能否在不同环境间保持。DECE 构建了覆盖十款欧式桌游的统一竞技场，提供共享接口与评测协议，这些游戏同时包含长期战略承诺、共享资源竞争与多条取胜路径。主实验评测 9 个模型与 4 种执行 harness 组成的 12 种配置，在十款游戏中完成 480 场三人对局，连同补充研究共 1032 场对局。结果显示跨游戏排名总体一致但也存在游戏特异性优势；同一模型在不同 harness 下表现差异明显，且竞技优势并不稳定转化为 token 或成本效率，因此应按跨游戏竞技表现与资源开销共同评估完整的智能体配置。
arxiv.reason: Agent 评测竞技场，对比跨游戏与 harness 差异，方向相关但属 benchmark 发布

arxiv.title: Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents
arxiv.abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model's calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65-77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16-53%) and the non-LLM methods (6-39%), on every model on which both families were run. The published agents fix from a tenth to all of their model calls in the program, and a case study shows how these prescriptions skip the decisive evidence. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes accuracy by a few points at most while multiplying the time by up to seven. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.
arxiv.titleZh: 自由观察，自由推理:简单的LLM harness在根因诊断上优于手工设计的根因分析Agent
arxiv.summaryZh: 微服务故障根因分析(RCA)领域涌现出大量手工编排的LLM Agent，典型做法是用标准作业流程、固定阶段与角色分工约束模型的调查过程，但各工作只在自有数据上与少量基线比较，无法判断这种设计是否优于让强模型自主调查。该工作在RCAtlas上系统比较了三类不规定模型调用方式的简单harness(单次调用证据包、SQL Agent、Codex编程Agent)、五个已发表的LLM RCA Agent，以及统计与因果方法;RCAtlas含来自八个公开数据集的90个经校验案例，覆盖六个模型与三档推理强度。简单harness最准确，三个中档模型上PR@1达65–77%，高于已发表Agent的16–53%与非LLM方法的6–39%，且在两类方法都运行的每个模型上均领先。已发表Agent把十分之一到全部的模型调用写死在程序中，案例研究显示这些预设会跳过关键证据;更强模型主要提升可靠性，多轮harness主要提升能力上限，而提高推理强度最多只带来几个百分点的准确率变化，耗时却最多增至七倍。
arxiv.reason: LLM Agent harness设计与评测方法学，直接命中Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: Improving Signals, Declining Encoder: A Known-Answer Test of Label-Free Monitoring in Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv.abstract: Self-supervised training is monitored without labels, through the loss and statistics of the learned features. We report a case where we know the encoders lost part of what they had learned, so we can check whether these signals noticed. We trained LeJEPA encoders on synthetic images with known generating factors. In nine of ten seeds, the readability of those factors fell abruptly and stayed down, nearly always along the same direction in factor space. Meanwhile the loss kept falling, and most of the eleven label-free signals we tracked kept improving and rated the declining runs better than runs that did not decline. Standard change-point detection rarely flagged the decline near its onset, and selecting checkpoints by these signals mostly chose ones after it.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nilotpal09/improving-signals-declining-encoder. Checkpoints: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23666713
arxiv.titleZh: 信号在改善，编码器在退化：自监督学习中无标签监控的已知答案测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 在生成因子已知的合成图像上训练 LeJEPA 自监督编码器，构造出编码器确实丢失已学信息的可控场景，以此检验无标签监控信号能否察觉这种退化。十个随机种子中有九个出现因子可读性骤降并持续偏低，且几乎沿因子空间的同一方向；同期损失继续下降，追踪的十一项无标签信号大多继续改善，并把退化run评得优于未退化run。标准变化点检测很少在退化起始附近报警，依这些信号挑选 checkpoint 多落在退化之后。结果说明常用无标签监控可能系统性掩盖表示质量下降，对自监督训练过程与模型选择的可信度提出警告。
arxiv.reason: 自监督表示退化与无标签监控可靠性，属评估方法学，但不在 LLM 主线

arxiv.title: Do Similarity Measures Measure Similarity? How User Activity Creates Phantom Correlation in Recommender Systems
arxiv.abstract: Item-item similarity is one of the oldest and most foundational signals in recommender systems: two items are assumed to be similar when the same users consume them. Despite the sparsity and scale of interaction data, the implicit assumption across the field is that item co-occurrence reflects genuine shared preference, capturing what users like together. In this paper, we demonstrate that a substantial fraction of observed item-item similarity is an artifact of variance in user activity rather than shared taste. Even if every user consumed items completely independently, differing only in their total consumption volume, standard similarity measures still detect strong associations between items. We term this phenomenon phantom correlation: spurious item association that emerges strictly from heterogeneous user activity in the complete absence of preference structure. Starting from minimal formal assumptions, we show that independent consumption under varying activity is described by a Rasch model, and we derive how the resulting association depends on item popularity for each similarity measure. By comparing our theoretical baseline against real-world benchmark datasets, we reveal the extent to which popular similarity measures reflect phantom correlation, which bears on how item co-occurrence is interpreted and used in collaborative filtering.
arxiv.titleZh: 相似度度量真的在度量相似性吗？用户活跃度如何在推荐系统中制造幻影相关性
arxiv.summaryZh: 物品—物品相似度的基本假设是「同一批用户消费即相似」，但其中相当大一部分关联可能只是用户活跃度差异造成的假象。从最小形式化假设出发，证明在活跃度异质、偏好完全独立的消费下，共现数据由 Rasch 模型描述，并针对每种常用相似度度量推导其关联强度随物品流行度的变化，给出理论基线。与真实基准数据集对比后，量化了流行相似度度量中有多少反映的是这种「幻影相关性」，直接影响协同过滤中共现信号的解释与使用方式。
arxiv.reason: 推荐系统相似度的方法学批判，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Beyond Physical Illness: Can Clinical Narratives Reveal Emerging Mental Health Risks in Chronically Ill Patients?
arxiv.abstract: Mental-health risks such as depression, dementia, and suicidal ideation can emerge during hospitalization among chronically ill patients and may worsen without timely recognition and intervention. However, most existing mental health studies focus on patients with established psychiatric conditions rather than patients hospitalized primarily for physical illness. In this work, we investigate whether latent mental-health risk in chronically ill patients can be inferred from longitudinal clinical narratives. We construct a weakly supervised cohort around 4,000 patients from MIMIC-III using mental-health evidence extracted from discharge summaries. A hierarchical state-space framework derives mental-health representations from day-wise clinical narratives and models their temporal evolution for risk estimation throughout hospitalization. Preliminary results demonstrate improved binary risk prediction using the proposed representations and show distinct model derived risk trajectories between risk and no-risk cohorts, providing a foundation for studying emerging mental-health risks in chronically ill patients.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越躯体疾病：临床叙事能否揭示慢性病患者的潜在心理健康风险？
arxiv.summaryZh: 住院慢性病患者的抑郁、痴呆与自杀意念等心理健康风险常被漏诊，而现有研究多聚焦已确诊的精神疾病人群。工作基于MIMIC-III构建约4000例患者的弱监督队列，从出院小结中抽取心理健康证据，并用分层状态空间框架从逐日临床叙事中提取心理健康表征、建模其时间演化以估计住院期间的风险。初步结果显示，该表征提升了二分类风险预测效果，且风险组与无风险组呈现明显不同的模型导出风险轨迹。可作为临床叙事驱动的心理健康风险早期筛查的基础探索。
arxiv.reason: 医疗垂直应用，非LLM方法学重点，落在低分方向

arxiv.title: CLOSURE: Cross-Channel Closure for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Multivariate time series produced by industrial installations and server clusters are under continuous monitoring, and anomaly detection is the first line of defense before a local fault escalates into a system-wide failure. In the absence of labels, the dominant paradigm trains a reconstruction model on normal data and scores the residual to reach a verdict. Recent work has steadily enriched the expressiveness of the recovery map through Transformers, diffusion models, and cross-scale associations. A residual, however, only certifies that an observation can be recovered; it does not certify that the variables still explain one another as they do under normal operation. A coordinated yet unfamiliar operating transition inflates the residual without breaking any relationship, whereas a sensor drifting away from its peers may leave the residual silent. Methods that fold inter-variable dependencies into the reconstruction objective inherit this ambiguity, because their relational evidence is ultimately supervised by the same recovery loss. We therefore propose CLOSURE, which evaluates recoverability and cross-channel consistency as two normal-data prediction tasks learned in separation. The recoverability task is solved by a diffusion reconstructor conditioned on a discrete memory of normal temporal bases. The consistency task is solved by a relation-closure operator that predicts every channel exclusively from the others, where the target's own trajectory is withheld and sparse signed gates decide which peers are actually used. The two scores are reconciled only through calibration on normal data. Extensive experiments show that CLOSURE consistently outperforms recent reconstruction-, frequency-, and topology-based detectors on public benchmark streams, confirming the value of examining consistency alongside recoverability.
arxiv.titleZh: CLOSURE:面向多变量时间序列异常检测的跨通道闭合
arxiv.summaryZh: 多变量时间序列异常检测中，仅靠重构残差判定异常存在盲区:整体工况协调漂移会抬高残差却未破坏变量间关系，单个传感器缓慢偏离同伴也可能不留残差痕迹。CLOSURE 把「可恢复性」与「跨通道一致性」拆成两个各自独立的正常数据预测任务:前者用扩散重构器并附加离散的正常时序基记忆作为条件，后者用关系闭合算子，在屏蔽目标通道自身轨迹的前提下仅由其余通道预测该通道，并以稀疏带符号门控选择真正参与的同侪通道;两路分数只在正常数据上做校准融合。在公开基准流上，CLOSURE 稳定优于近期的重构类、频域类与拓扑类检测器，说明在可恢复性之外单独考察通道一致性是有价值的。
arxiv.reason: 多变量时序异常检测，扩散重构为主，与 LLM 主线无关

arxiv.title: SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy
arxiv.abstract: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a $76.0\%$ ASR@1 within an average of $3.0$ turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is $54.8\%$ with fixed $7$ turns and the best interactive baseline is $43.8\%$ in $3.7$ turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average $59.6\%$ ASR@1 on HarmBench, $13.8\%$ over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA
arxiv.titleZh: SEMA-Auto：有视野且高效的多轮自主攻击
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多轮越狱攻击中静态规划看不到受害者回复、浪费轮次且迁移性差，而交互式生成依赖在环评估器提供成功信号、成本高且性能虚高的问题，提出 SEMA-Auto：攻击模型与受害者模型交互，并在成功后自主终止会话。训练分两阶段，先用引导轨迹微调注入攻击目标与合规决策的概念，再以决策监督强化学习联合但分离地优化越狱奖励与每轮决策相对绝对目标的监督。在多个数据集、受害者与评判器上取得 SOTA，几乎以最少轮次完成攻击：AdvBench 上对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 平均 3.0 轮内达 76.0% ASR@1，而最佳静态基线为 54.8%（固定 7 轮）、最佳交互基线为 43.8%（3.7 轮）；对 GPT-oss-120B、GPT-5.4、Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-6-Astra 等安全加固前沿模型，在 HarmBench 上平均 59.6% ASR@1，超先前 SOTA 13.8%。
arxiv.reason: 多轮越狱攻击的 RL 训练，涉及安全对齐但非核心方向

arxiv.title: LUCID: Local Understanding of Covariate Importance with Conditional Density Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Computing local-level variable importance (VI) is critical for understanding machine learning models. Local permutation-based VI metrics offer a simple yet powerful approach, measuring how much a model's output changes when perturbing its inputs. However, existing perturbation strategies often ignore feature dependence or account for it only through restricted approximations. Perturbing a feature without fully respecting this dependence can generate unrealistic counterfactuals, thereby evaluating the model in regions unsupported by the observed data distribution. We address this gap by introducing a new model-agnostic local VI metric and estimator, Local Understanding of Covariate Importance with conditional Density estimation (LUCID). LUCID perturbs features of interest using plausible values drawn from the full conditional distribution given the remaining observed features. We establish theoretical connections between LUCID and existing VI measures, and provide an estimator with convergence guarantees and uncertainty quantification. Finally, we demonstrate LUCID's stable performance and practical utility across simulated and real-world examples.
arxiv.titleZh: LUCID:基于条件密度估计的局部协变量重要性理解
arxiv.summaryZh: 局部变量重要性度量中，基于置换的方法若忽略特征依赖，会生成观测分布之外的反事实样本，导致归因失真。LUCID 用条件密度估计从剩余特征的完整条件分布中采样可行值来扰动目标特征，给出模型无关的局部重要性度量与估计器，并建立其与既有 VI 指标的理论联系，提供收敛性保证与不确定性量化。在模拟与真实数据上，LUCID 表现稳定且实用。工作属于通用机器学习可解释性方法，与 LLM 后训练、Agent 等方向无直接交集。
arxiv.reason: 模型无关的可解释性统计方法，与 LLM 关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.
arxiv.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 1 table (plus 3 figures, 3 tables, and 2 algorithms in the appendix)
arxiv.titleZh: 多目标多智能体强化学习中的偏好引导合作
arxiv.summaryZh: 多目标多智能体强化学习通常把「多智能体协作」与「多目标权衡」当作两个独立问题处理，导致复杂度急剧膨胀。该工作转而在团队与个体两个层级上形式化 MOMARL，提出按目标维度的反事实信用分配，用于衡量每个智能体在团队各目标上的贡献;并给出元梯度引导的多目标多智能体强化学习 MIRL，含静态(MIRL-S)与动态(MIRL-D)两个变体，使智能体各自学习目标优先级、同时集体优化系统级目标，让多目标结构本身直接引导合作。在多目标多粒子环境上的实验显示，方法相对基线提升了 Pareto 前沿质量，动态变体表现最佳。
arxiv.reason: 经典多智能体强化学习，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无直接交集

arxiv.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
arxiv.abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.
arxiv.comment: 30 pages. To appear at NeurIPS 2026 (extended version)
arxiv.titleZh: 使用路由集成与轨迹归因的多目标强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 多目标强化学习中，最优策略会随目标权重组合剧烈变化，目标冲突越强，逐偏好单独学习策略就越样本低效。为此引入「目标冲突系数」，并在在线设定下给出近最优 regret 界，量化目标错位对学习效率的影响;提出路由集成策略学习，维护少量基策略，并按潜在回报把轨迹动态路由到最合适的策略;还把轨迹选择作为缓解目标冲突的另一手段，设计核代理轨迹归因算法，估计一组轨迹的反馈信号如何影响其他轨迹上的策略学习，核函数可刻画轨迹间的协同与对抗等非线性交互。在 Meta-World 与 MO-Gymnasium 的在线环境中，平均性能较基线提升 4.3%;核归因与 leave-one-out 分析的相关性比现有基线高 50%，用于轨迹选择时回报提升 27%。
arxiv.reason: 多目标权衡与 RLHF 偏好冲突相关，但无 LLM 实验，偏通用 RL

arxiv.title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
arxiv.abstract: Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental Learning (TSCIL) essential for adapting to new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, preserving diverse and evolving class distributions under strict privacy and memory constraints remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between retaining sufficient historical knowledge for accurate recognition and minimizing the memory required for continual adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a memory-efficient, replay-free framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling rather than sample rehearsal. TRACE employs a compact, frozen temporal-spectral representation and lightweight class-specific autoencoders to capture complex intra-class variations. By independently preserving each class model, TRACE avoids recursive generation and catastrophic forgetting, while enabling direct classification through reconstruction-based scoring without retaining historical samples or large statistical matrices. Extensive experiments across five TSCIL benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE achieves competitive classification accuracy while reducing mean retained memory by approximately 98.26% compared with TS-ACL, the strongest evaluated analytical baseline, and achieving an approximately 33.43% relative improvement in accuracy on GrabMyo.
arxiv.titleZh: TRACE：通过时频重建实现内存高效的时间序列类增量学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 时间序列类增量学习在隐私与内存严格受限的条件下，难以既保留历史类别分布又持续适应新类别。TRACE 采用冻结的紧凑时频表示与轻量级类特定自编码器建模类内变化，各类模型独立保存以避免递归生成和灾难性遗忘，并通过重建误差打分直接分类，无需回放历史样本或保存大型统计矩阵。在五个 TSCIL 基准上，其准确率具有竞争力，平均保留内存相比最强分析基线 TS-ACL 降低约 98.26%，在 GrabMyo 上准确率相对提升约 33.43%。该工作适用于传感类流式数据的无回放增量学习场景。
arxiv.reason: 时间序列类增量学习，与 LLM 后训练和 Agent 方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
arxiv.abstract: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.
arxiv.titleZh: JEV 能否支持临床试验标准评估？
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床试验预筛需要区分「条件不满足」与「证据不足」。在零数据保留约束下，回顾性比较非生成式决策模型 JEV（直接输出选项概率）与受 schema 约束的 Qwen Flash，覆盖 TrialGPT 及源自 MIMIC-III/IV 的 2048 个患者—条件对。批量模式下 JEV 在 MIMIC-III 的宏 F1 显著更高（0.768 vs. 0.534，Δ=+0.234），主要来自「信息不足」标签召回提升（56.3% vs 9.9%），并伴随更低延迟（1.18–1.40 s vs 2.80–8.90 s）与低 53%–74% 的单条件成本。JEV 适合作为输出条目级判断并标记信息缺口的初筛组件。
arxiv.reason: 临床试验预筛的垂直应用，与后训练/Agent 主线关联有限

arxiv.title: Quantifying the failure of symmetry learning in linear diffusion models due to initialization and finite-sample effects
arxiv.abstract: Data distributions often possess one or more symmetries: for example, all orientations of any specific dog are included in the distribution of all possible dog pictures. Despite the omnipresence of such symmetries, modern generative modeling approaches may fail to incorporate or learn them, which can lead to lower sample efficiency and poorer generalization. To what extent do diffusion models fail to learn data distribution symmetries, and what sources of symmetry breaking are most responsible? Here, we answer this question in the theoretically tractable setting of linear diffusion models. We show that of three potential sources of symmetry breaking---a non-symmetric initial weight matrix, a noisy learning target, and finite-sample noise---target noise produces the most robust symmetry breaking, since it persists even in the sample-rich regime. Using local laws from random matrix theory, we derive formulas for average symmetry error in fairly general cases involving symmetry within a subspace and show that smaller symmetries are harder to learn.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
arxiv.titleZh: 量化线性扩散模型中由初始化与有限样本效应导致的对称性学习失败
arxiv.summaryZh: 数据分布常含有对称性，但扩散模型未必能学到，从而损害样本效率与泛化。该工作在可理论分析的线性扩散模型设定下，比较三种对称性破缺来源:非对称初始权重、带噪学习目标与有限样本噪声，并借助随机矩阵理论的局部律，在含子空间对称的较一般情形下推导平均对称误差公式。结果显示目标噪声造成的破缺最稳健，即便在样本充足时依然存在，且更小的对称性更难学。结论为生成模型样本效率与泛化的差异提供了理论解释。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型对称性理论研究，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无关

arxiv.title: Audit Where Hacks Pay: Budgeted Strong-Verifier Audits Against Reward Hacking in GRPO
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains on cheap checks, such as unit tests, that a policy can learn to game, while a stronger check is too expensive to run on every rollout. We study how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO, separating which weakly passing rollouts to audit from what reward a caught hack receives. At a fixed policy state with centered advantages, the expected update depends on a design only through each rollout's marginal audit probability and correction; reflecting a caught hack's reward about the failure reward negates the advantages of an all-hack group; and auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits, LB) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks among pass-count designs with a fixed correction when a label's value falls with the pass count. We tested this analysis in actual LLM training: from each run's starting state, the sign of this mass on a frozen panel predicted whether hacking would be suppressed in 33 of 39 runs, including 13 of 16 preregistered ones. In LeetCode (Wong et al., 2026) and Countdown-Code (Khalifa et al., 2026), LB drives hacking to near zero, while random audits with the same penalty and budget do not and use more labels. We also find that the randomness of the update affects training: in Countdown-Code, two unbiased corrections, per-item reward-level IPW and a group-level advantage correction, bring hacking down too but end 6.1-11.8 and 8.0-11.5 points lower in held-out accuracy than LB at the same budget. A full audit, which the group-level correction reproduces in expectation, stays within about two points of LB in three seeds, while LB uses 28% of its labels, and allocating the same correction by pass count recovers most of the loss (one seed). Training outcomes thus depend not only on the expected update but also on the randomness of its estimate.
arxiv.titleZh: 在作弊有利可图处审计：面向GRPO中奖励黑客的预算受限强验证器审计
arxiv.summaryZh: RLVR依赖单元测试等廉价检查，策略可学会钻空子，而强验证器太贵、无法对每条 rollout 全量运行。该工作把强验证器预算的分配拆成两个设计维度：审计哪些弱通过 rollout、被抓作弊的奖励如何设定；基于中心化优势的期望更新分析，给出两点结论——把被抓作弊的奖励关于失败奖励做反射，可抵消全作弊组的优势；在通过数设计下，「弱通过最少者优先、整组审计」的 LB 策略使留在作弊上的优势质量最小。在 LeetCode 与 Countdown-Code 上，LB 把作弊压到近零，同预算随机审计则不能且消耗更多标签；同一预算下 LB 的留出准确率比逐项 IPW 与组级优势校正分别高 6.1–11.8 与 8.0–11.5 点，而全量审计仅比 LB 高约 2 点却用掉 3.6 倍标签。结论是训练结果不只取决于期望更新，也取决于其估计的随机性。
arxiv.reason: GRPO奖励黑客治理，理论分析加真实训练验证，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Quantitative Generalization Bounds for Multi-Layer Transformers: A Few Long Strings can Beat Many Short Ones
arxiv.abstract: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones.These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.
arxiv.titleZh: 多层 Transformer 的定量泛化界：少量长字符串可胜过大量短字符串
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Transformer 的分布内泛化与长度外推长期被分开研究的问题，对固定精度 Transformer 给出二者联合的泛化保证，界由模型参数量、量化空间与字符表大小刻画。理论进一步揭示样本数与训练长度的权衡：增大训练长度可比增大样本数带来指数级效率提升，即少量长序列胜过大量短序列，实验验证了理论预测。为长上下文训练数据配比与长度外推提供定量依据。
arxiv.reason: Transformer 长度泛化与样本复杂度的定量理论，直击架构与预训练关注点

arxiv.title: Detecting bus delays and service anomalies in Niterói with autoencoder latent feature representations
arxiv.abstract: Bus riders judge service by two failures: single trips that run late, and days on which the whole system misbehaves. We ask whether one unsupervised representation of raw GPS telemetry can serve both diagnoses on the NetMob 2026 Niterói bus dataset. An autoencoder compresses each trip into a 64-dimensional latent vector; the frozen encoder feeds supervised delay classifiers, and the reconstruction error serves as an anomaly score. Two findings are negative. First, the latent representation does not improve delay detection: gradient boosting on per-trip summary features reaches $0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC against $0.838 \pm 0.016$ for the best latent setup, and the gap becomes significant once the preprocessing filters are relaxed. Second, two of the three external checks of the anomaly score were circular. Retraining without rainfall removes the rain association ($5.4\%$ against $5.0\%$ flagged, $p = 0.84$) and an apparent citywide disruption on 23 March. What survives is a day-level signal stable across three autoencoders (Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$), driven mostly by day type, with degraded-telemetry days still separable within weekday and weekend strata. The alarm threshold limits detection more than the score does: a pooled percentile cut flags $5.7\%$ of trips on the worst degraded day, while re-scaling within each bus line flags $29.3\%$. The delay model rests almost entirely on one feature, no latent dimension is individually interpretable, and 22 chronic line-directions carry half of all delayed trips.
arxiv.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Full report for the NetMob 2026 Data Challenge (Niterói, Brazil). Winner of the Best Poster award
arxiv.titleZh: 用自编码器潜在特征表示检测尼泰罗伊的公交延误与服务异常
arxiv.summaryZh: 在NetMob 2026尼泰罗伊公交GPS数据上检验一套无监督表示能否同时服务于单程延误分类与全天系统性异常检测：自编码器把每趟行程压成64维潜在向量，冻结编码器接监督延误分类器，重构误差作异常分数。结果为负：潜在表示未提升延误检测，逐行程汇总特征的梯度提升ROC-AUC达0.846±0.013，最优潜在方案为0.838±0.016，放宽预处理过滤后差距显著；三项异常分数外部校验中有两项属循环论证，去掉降雨重训后降雨关联消失（5.4%对5.0%，p=0.84）。仍成立的是跨三个自编码器稳定的日级信号（Spearman ρ≥0.96），主要由日期类型驱动，且告警阈值比分数本身更限制检出率——全池百分位切法在最差退化日仅标记5.7%行程，按线路内重新缩放则标记29.3%。
arxiv.reason: 公交GPS异常检测，属交通垂直应用，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: Triage:在视频扩散 Transformer 中对注意力 tile 进行跳过、略读或精修
arxiv.summaryZh: 视频扩散 Transformer 的推理被数万视觉 token 上的注意力计算主导，现有稀疏化、低精度方法对所有保留 tile 采用同一精度，忽略了近似误差在 tile 间的巨大差异。Triage 是一种免训练的三级注意力机制:按块统计量用轻量 router 将每个 tile 分到「用块均值替代以跳过」「NVFP4 略读」「NVFP4 残差校正精修」三级，仅当预测误差下降足以抵偿额外计算时才升级精度，并由单一价格参数控制权衡;配套融合 kernel 在 RTX Blackwell 的 FP4 张量核上单趟执行三级。在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo、LTX-2.5 上端到端生成较稠密 FlashAttention 最高加速 2.32 倍，五个设置中均快于所有基线，PSNR 比最佳基线高 0.3–3.0 dB。
arxiv.reason: 视频扩散生成属低分方向，但 tile 级稀疏与 FP4 效率方法略有借鉴价值

arxiv.title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
arxiv.abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.
arxiv.titleZh: 可解释多模态AI方法用于减少不必要的乳腺活检
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对被建议活检的BI-RADS 4/5高风险患者，构建影像-文本多模态框架判断肿瘤是否良性，以减少不必要的活检：用ViT提取四视角乳腺X线影像特征，用DeBERTa-V3-Large编码对应放射科报告，两模态独立提取特征后做晚期融合再分类，并用Grad-CAM生成影响预测的关键区域可视化解释。在1632例院内数据上，最佳AUC为0.72，优于纯影像的0.66与纯文本的0.68；灵敏度为90%–100%时，对应特异性为40%–11%。该工作展示了多模态融合与可解释性在乳腺诊断辅助中的可行性，但其证据来自单中心自建数据集。
arxiv.reason: 医疗影像与乳腺诊断应用，完全落在低分方向

arxiv.title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
arxiv.abstract: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost. This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries. Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.
arxiv.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Reproduction artifacts available at https://github.com/harinechoi/confidence-auditing-reproduction
arxiv.titleZh: 从自置信度到统计准确率:用直接审计与LLM辅助审计扩展人在回路评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对模型自报置信度校准不佳、人工审计成本高的问题，构建统一统计框架:直接审计路线采用置信度分层抽样，在无需置信度校准的前提下从部分核验输出恢复总体准确率，并刻画有限样本不确定性;judge辅助路线以敏感度与假阳性率建模judge，给出带校准不确定性的误差校正估计量，并通过人工标注量与总成本两条效率边界比较两种路线。在MMLU-Pro与MMMU-Pro上，失准的自置信度仍能支撑统计有效的分层审计，置信度分布高度不均衡时按比例分配相比等额分层分配显著降低估计误差;但仅少数目标–验证器对满足理想的人工标注效率条件，自动推理成本进一步压缩了可节省空间。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge与人工审计的统计框架，评测方法学方向扎实

arxiv.title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
arxiv.abstract: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.
arxiv.comment: 20 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://github.com/runchu-tian/MiRL
arxiv.titleZh: MiRL:面向终端 Agent 错误行为的定向强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 终端 Agent 需在命令行中完成长程任务，现有错误定向方法只适用于单轮任务，失败分析也仅用于评估与调试而非训练。MiRL 先对策略的出错步骤做画像，挖掘跨环境反复出现、可泛化的「不当行为」类型，再以这些步骤为 rollout 起点做 RL，仅当轨迹通过测试且不再犯该行为时给奖励。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，8 类不当行为覆盖 52.1% 的错误步骤;训练后在未见前缀上重犯率平均下降 43%–57%,Terminal-Bench Lite 达 51.8%(TMax-4B 为 47.4%),Terminal-Bench 2.1 上 21.3% 对 20.6%，且 rollout 用量仅为其 35%。该结果说明错误定向学习可落地到真实长程终端任务。
arxiv.reason: 终端 Agent 的错误定向 RL，命中 Agentic RL 与代码智能方向

arxiv.title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向深度 CTR 预测的输入侧维度配置统一框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 深度 CTR 预测的精度不仅取决于特征交互结构，也取决于交互建模前的输入侧配置，而现有工作分别在样本、特征、embedding 单元三个层面独立做选择，忽视了各层共享的基本形式与跨层依赖。OptIDC 将三层选择机制整合进统一框架联合学习，并引入选择加权最优传输机制，在有限测度上对齐粗粒度与细粒度选择，以缓解跨层选择冲突并保留各层语义。该框架与具体 CTR 模型无关，可直接嵌入现有模型;在四个真实数据集上 AUC 一致优于现有输入侧选择方法，说明统一化的输入侧维度配置有效。
arxiv.reason: CTR 预估的输入侧选择，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.
arxiv.titleZh: 并非单一信念：对话问答中的答案载荷、持续性与分离的置信信号
arxiv.summaryZh: 对话问答系统需在用户追问时纠正错误并提示可信答案。研究把每次追问拆成言语行为（重问、赞同、质疑）与答案载荷，在同一批记录上比较言语化置信、长度归一化似然、冻结隐状态探针与P(True)四类信号。结果显示只有用户给出答案串才会大幅改变答案，正确载荷的修复率至少是重问或赞同的四倍；Qwen2.5-7B上冻结探针随答案持续性而非真实性上升，四种信号彼此不一致。含答案的BM25证据能修复67–76%的顽固错误，而无答案串时修复率低于0.15，表明可部署门控在不知金标时仍难纠错。
arxiv.reason: 对话问答纠错与置信信号评测，属评测可靠性方向

arxiv.title: GNN-VIEW: Visual Inspection and Explanation of Graph-based Earth-System Models
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development. Graph-based models, one of the most prominent approaches, allow developers to constrain the learning process before training via graph connectivity. Yet, developing these models remains challenging: the graph is built algorithmically with little intuition about the final result beyond static plotting, which requires extra work and is often not detailed enough. Even after successful training, how the model arrives at forecasts remains obscure. We present GNN-VIEW, an interactive browser-based tool that supports the development of such systems. GNN-VIEW exposes the graph's information pathways, allowing model developers to debug the graph structure before training. After training, GNN-VIEW uses attribution-based explainability to reveal which input features are used by the trained model for a given forecast. This helps developers understand why a model fails. We showcase the usefulness of GNN-VIEW in the construction stage of a graph for an ocean forecasting model, and in explaining poorly predicted precipitation of a trained weather forecasting model during Hurricane Laura.

arxiv.titleZh: GNN-VIEW：图结构地球系统模型的可视化检查与解释

arxiv.title: EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter, a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router's own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. Cost-aware reinforcement learning jointly optimizes task performance and computational cost. Together, these training signals internalize execution insights into the routing policy. The updated policy generates new trajectories that support subsequent insight extraction, forming an execution-driven self-improvement loop. We evaluate EvoRouter on 19 in-domain datasets spanning five domains and two out-of-domain benchmarks. EvoRouter achieves an average in-domain accuracy of 68.69%, outperforming the strongest routing baseline by 7.23 percentage points while reducing inference compute cost by 50.95%. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/CenYangtze/EvoRouter.
arxiv.titleZh: EvoRouter：通过洞察引导的在线策略蒸馏实现成本高效的多智能体路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 大规模服务Web查询时，多智能体系统需要联合配置模型、协作模式、智能体数量、交互轮次与技能，配置空间呈组合爆炸，而稀疏的执行奖励难以对相互依赖的规划决策提供细粒度监督。EvoRouter让一个专职专家周期性把跨任务的配置轨迹与性能—成本反馈综合为可复用的条件路由洞察，再由特权教师结合这些洞察与当前执行反馈，通过在线策略蒸馏为路由器自身规划轨迹提供token级稠密监督，并与成本感知强化学习联合优化任务表现与计算开销，形成执行驱动的自我改进闭环。在覆盖5个领域的19个域内数据集与2个域外基准上，平均域内准确率达68.69%，超出最强路由基线7.23个百分点，同时推理算力成本降低50.95%。该工作为多智能体系统的自适应编排与成本控制提供了可复用的训练范式。

arxiv.title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.
arxiv.titleZh: 将LLM-SC适配到活态神圣遗产：Pashupatinath神庙评论上的领域特定抽取、语义网络与人工评估

arxiv.title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
arxiv.abstract: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.
arxiv.titleZh: CounterFlow：面向视觉反事实的目标条件流匹配
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向可解释 AI 中的视觉反事实解释生成，解决现有 GAN/扩散方法计算开销大、修改真实性不足的问题。CounterFlow 基于条件流匹配，以目标类别条件向量场把源图像直接推向用户指定类别，并在原始像素空间完成语义修改。标准基准上，其在视觉真实性与目标类切换上达到 SOTA，计算开销显著低于 GAN/扩散架构，更适合实际部署。

arxiv.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
arxiv.abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: 评估 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 的失控与有害操纵风险
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对开源权重模型缺乏前沿风险第三方评估的空白，依据 EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice 与 AEF-1 标准，对采用新架构、扩大训练规模且具备较强 Agent 能力的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 开展独立安全评测，覆盖 34 个基准（含 5 个自建套件），维度包括评测完整性、失控与有害操纵，并与 V4.1 Flash、早期 V4 系列及 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.8 Flash 对比。结果显示该模型相对 V4 代际有显著安全提升，在多个维度接近或追平领先闭源基线，但仍存在需持续关注的行为。报告据此提出三点建议：将安全评测纳入小幅增量发布、以推理轨迹与动作日志的过程级可观测性替代仅看最终轮输出与终态检查、以及建设私有基准以规避评测意识与数据污染。

arxiv.title: SCAFFOLD under Hessian Similarity: Sharp Convergence Rates
arxiv.abstract: One of the main challenges of federated learning is heterogeneous data split among the clients, leading to biased local updates called client drift. The SCAFFOLD algorithm (Karimireddy et al., 2020) corrects client drift with control variates, but its relation to the similarity of client data is not yet fully understood: the original similarity-based guarantees cover only quadratics with a stronger second-order similarity assumption, and a follow-up weakly convex analysis (Luo et al., 2025) obtains a $\sqrt{Lδ}$ dependence for $L$-smooth losses with averaged Hessian similarity $δ$. We analyze SCAFFOLD with minibatch-based control variates and establish linear dependence on Hessian similarity beyond quadratics, for both convex and nonconvex objectives. In particular, for convex objectives with exact gradients, $R$ SCAFFOLD rounds with $K$ local steps lead to an objective gap of order $(L/K+δ)D_0^2/R$, where $D_0$ is the initial distance to a minimizer. When $K=Θ(L/δ)$, it improves the minibatch SGD rate by a factor $Θ(L/δ)$. For nonconvex objectives, we prove an analogous stationarity guarantee under uniform Hessian similarity for a client-selection variant. In both settings, we extend these guarantees to stochastic gradients and prove matching lower bounds for the analyzed methods with constant local stepsizes. We also show that, under partial participation, even identical clients need not obtain the full communication benefit of additional local steps.
arxiv.titleZh: Hessian相似性下的SCAFFOLD：紧致的收敛速率
arxiv.summaryZh: 联邦学习中客户端数据异构会造成客户端漂移，SCAFFOLD用控制变量校正这一偏差，但其收敛性与数据相似性的关系此前仅在二次目标或弱凸假设下清楚。该工作基于小批量控制变量，在凸与非凸目标上给出对平均Hessian相似度δ的线性依赖：凸情形下R轮通信、每轮K步本地更新使目标间隙达(L/K+δ)D₀²/R量级，取K=Θ(L/δ)时比小批量SGD快Θ(L/δ)倍；非凸情形在均匀Hessian相似性下用客户端选择变体给出平稳性保证，并扩展到随机梯度、给出匹配下界，还说明部分参与时即使客户端同分布也未获额外本地步对应的全部通信收益。

arxiv.title: A Hybrid Framework for Explainable Aviation Risk: Causal Chain Extraction from Safety Reports with Physics-Based Failure Quantification and Interventional Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Aviation authorities hold decades of accident reports whose narratives record how investigators reconstructed each accident. Computational work on these archives has mostly sorted reports into fixed taxonomies. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework in which a text-based corpus identifies the leading factors of a failure mode. Physics-based models then quantify how likely that failure is at a stated operating point. Ordered causal chains extracted from 56,202 American accident reports with a local large language model aggregate into a causation knowledge graph. On an evaluation sample of 2,000 reports, the chains recover 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes. Each physical factor whose drivers the record carries receives an occurrence model calibrated to the accident population. A leaky noisy-OR fitted to the corpus combines the factors into a failure mode probability that supports intervention. For engine power loss, the carburetor icing model separates 1,205 icing accidents from other accidents using temperature and dewpoint alone, reaching 0.61 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve against a density ratio ceiling of 0.64. Routine weather hours give no valid control, because flying concentrates in fair weather. On later years the physics adds 0.03 to that area for occurrence and nothing for severity, so its value lies in interpretability. On four named accidents, abduction gives a probability of necessity of 0.29 to 0.50 for the heat omission, under monotonicity. The Fast Causal Inference algorithm does not license the largest backdoor adjustment on the learned networks.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向可解释航空风险的混合框架：从安全报告中抽取因果链，并结合基于物理的失效量化与干预分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 用本地大模型从56,202份美国航空事故报告中抽取有序因果链，并聚合成因果知识图谱；在2,000份评测样本上，这些因果链覆盖90.8%的调查员标注原因。物理模型为每个因素建立发生率模型，再通过leaky noisy-OR合成失效模式概率，以支持干预分析。化油器结冰案例中，仅用温度与露点即可区分1,205起结冰事故，AUC 0.61（密度比上限0.64），但物理项在后年份仅提升0.03，价值主要在可解释性；四起命名事故中热源遗漏的必要性概率为0.29–0.50。

arxiv.title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
arxiv.abstract: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.
arxiv.titleZh: 用片段读出与选择性适配改进 JEV 蕴含重排序
arxiv.summaryZh: JEV 决策模型把语言模型主干与轻量打分头结合，在自然语言候选中做选择；直接选择在一个请求内比较候选，而蕴含重排序要对每个候选单独发起一次以固定关系选项为标签的 NLI 请求，原有用在直接选择上的读出与适配方案是否仍然有效尚不清楚。工作将 mean-span 读出与选择性主干适配结合：前者用 NLI 选项内部上下文状态的平均替代选项末尾指针，且不增加打分头参数；后者只在注意力与 gated DeltaNet 投影上保留低秩更新，去掉前馈适配器。在汇总七个来源、十一种重排序配置的 MC11 指标上，选择性适配使 NeoHorse-1-4B 的准确率高于全模块基线，同时可训练参数减少一半以上，mean-span 池化在相同参数量下带来一致增益。

arxiv.title: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
arxiv.abstract: Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. It admits a closed-form expression for affine Gaussian transport and tractable Monte Carlo estimators otherwise. Treating the tNTK as the covariance function of a Gaussian process, we greedily select inputs that minimize the total GP posterior variance across the pool, yielding a distribution-aware active learning strategy. We evaluate this strategy across four classes of conditional generative models, including conditional flow matching and conditional Monge gap, on synthetic distributions, intent-labeled sentences, and single-cell perturbation responses. In these experiments, the tNTK outperforms the baseline NTK computed from the conditional mean, demonstrating the value of distribution-aware active learning for generative-modeling tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于传输神经正切核的条件生成模型主动学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 高通量科学实验常产生分布型输出，需要条件生成模型在新条件下预测，而新条件（如新抗原、细胞类型）的数据采集代价高昂，现有主动学习框架却只支持标量或向量输出。工作证明条件生成任务的 Wasserstein 检验风险可分解为均值项与形状项，据此提出传输神经正切核（tNTK）刻画预测分布对参数的敏感度：确定性极限下退化为标准 NTK，小扰动下上界预测的后验 Fréchet 方差，并有闭式或蒙特卡洛估计。以 tNTK 为高斯过程协方差贪心选取使总后验方差最小的输入，在条件流匹配、条件 Monge gap 等四类模型上，于合成分布、意图标注句子与单细胞扰动响应数据上优于基于条件均值的 NTK。

arxiv.title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
arxiv.abstract: We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron. First we prove a strong form of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture on neurons over finite fields, where the activation function is a certain modification of the discrete logarithm, using the Weil bound on multiplicative character sums over finite fields. Then we show a generalisation of Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons with a weight vector independent of the target function, positively answering another question in the literature. The proof of the latter uses an equidistribution theorem for the dilates of certain maps into tori.
arxiv.titleZh: Bovdi–Geche通用性猜想强形式的证明及一个复类比
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对单神经元神经网络的通用性问题给出两个定理：一是在有限域上，对激活函数为离散对数某种变形的神经元，证明Bovdi–Geche通用性猜想的一个强形式；二是把Aizenberg关于复二值神经元的通用性定理推广到权重向量不依赖目标函数的情形，正面回答文献中的问题。证明分别使用有限域乘法特征和的Weil界，以及到环面的一类映射伸缩的等分布定理。该结果属于神经网络表达能力的基础理论，偏纯数学，与LLM工程实践距离较远。
arxiv.reason: 纯神经网络数学理论，与LLM无关，方向不匹配

arxiv.title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
arxiv.abstract: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Pretrain to Adapt
arxiv.titleZh: 为规划而适应，而非仅为预测:乐观的测试时世界模型自适应
arxiv.summaryZh: 潜在世界模型通常离线预训练后在测试时冻结，分布偏移下规划性能会退化。用于规划的测试时自适应(TTA)是闭环的:规划器用模型 rollout 选动作，产生的转移又驱动下一次更新，因此预测误差低未必带来更好的规划。受自适应控制中奖励偏置最大似然启发，OpTTA的目标包含两项——观测转移上的预测损失，以及规划器在候选 rollout 上的目标达成代价，二者均对模型参数最小化，无需额外环境交互即可让模型对达成目标保持乐观。在操作、到达与导航任务的视觉与环境偏移下，仅自适应预测器时最终规划成功率平均比冻结模型高13.5个百分点(仅预测目标为6.9)，同时自适应编码器时为13.5对7.5，覆盖三个JEPA世界模型以及CEM与梯度规划器。

arxiv.title: Offline Language-Based Support System for Tactical Decision-Making in Air Combat Operations
arxiv.abstract: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. Average ratings ranged from 4.00 to 4.40 on a five-point scale, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest score, and the pilots rated the response time of the tool as fully adequate compared to manual search. The relevance of the retrieved content was identified as the main point for improvement. Potential applications are discussed in onboard mission systems, flight simulators, and training environments.

arxiv.title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
arxiv.abstract: The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years. Recent machine learning advances achieve high predictive performance of instability dynamics, but as black-box systems cannot be interpreted to connect to existing scientific understanding. Here we show analytic equations that predict when a multi-planet system will undergo instability. We discover these equations by first training a neural network on a dataset of N-body simulations, and then distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions. Our two-stage pipeline first learns an interpretable variable basis, then searches for equations using symbolic regression. The resulting equations outperform existing analytic estimates of instability and apply across wide ranges of mass ratios, spacing, and orbital eccentricities. They capture structure in the prediction landscape with a small number of variables amenable to dynamical interpretation. These results demonstrate how symbolic learning can be combined with neural networks to extract scientific insight from complex dynamical systems.

arxiv.titleZh: 将神经网络蒸馏为方程以预测行星系统不稳定性
arxiv.summaryZh: 多行星系统何时动力学失稳是被悬置三百年的解析难题，黑箱模型虽预测准确却难与既有理论衔接。该工作先在 N 体模拟数据集上训练神经网络，再把其隐知识蒸馏为闭式代数表达式：先学习可解释的变量基，再用符号回归搜索方程。所得方程在质量比、间距与偏心率的大范围内优于现有解析失稳判据，并以少量可作动力学解释的变量刻画预测景观的结构。该两阶段流程展示了符号学习与神经网络结合、从复杂动力系统中提取科学洞见的可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 符号回归加网络蒸馏发现解析方程，属 AI for Science 但非 LLM 方向

arxiv.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
arxiv.abstract: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向编码智能体的分层技能进化
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码轨迹往往与具体任务和仓库上下文强绑定，难以蒸馏出可跨环境迁移的过程性技能。HSE 通过分层证据聚合逐级提炼：先抽取任务级证据，再在同一仓库内聚合反复出现的证据形成仓库级技能候选，最后跨仓库整合一致模式得到可迁移技能；全过程由外部 writer–evaluator 循环驱动，底层编码模型保持冻结，仅外部更新 writer 与 evaluator 策略。仅从 SWE-Gym 进化出的 10 个技能，即在 SWE-bench Verified 与 DeepSWE 上跨 GLM-5.2、GPT-5.5、Opus 4.8 及 Pi、Claude Code 等多种 harness 一致提升；在不使用 verifier 反馈、仅靠学习到的 evaluator 评估候选时，针对目标基准进化技能库还能获得额外增益。该工作给出了不改动模型权重、可持续积累可复用经验的 coding agent 路径。
arxiv.reason: 编码 Agent 技能进化与跨基准、跨模型迁移，直接命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

arxiv.title: Making Reasoning Visible: Configuration-Aware Diagnostic Modeling for Adaptive Scaffolding in Structured Reasoning Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Modeling the latent, multi-step reasoning processes of learners is a core challenge for adaptive tutoring systems, which often rely on simple right/wrong answers rather than understanding how students think. Instantiated here for grammatical reasoning, this study introduces a diagnostic framework that makes students' step-by-step problem-solving visible by analyzing their action sequences in an interactive learning game. The framework computes five interpretable strategy dimensions (e.g., systematic error correction, random guessing), estimates coordination demand from task structure and behavioral patterns, and classifies reasoning into four distinct states. Analyzing 36,234 interactions from 234 students working on 42 morphosyntactic exercises, we found that reasoning strategies vary primarily by context rather than stable traits (intraclass correlation = 0.14), and students show high persistence in unproductive states; specifically, 74.6% of failures driven by high coordination demand (rather than simple knowledge gaps) are followed by another failure without intervention. Our early warning model predicts validation success with strong accuracy (AUC = 0.826 using strategy patterns alone; 0.902 with additional sequential context) while avoiding circular reliance on current error counts. These findings demonstrate that making latent reasoning processes visible enables earlier, more targeted scaffolding that responds to how students are thinking rather than simply whether they succeed. While demonstrated in language learning, the framework provides a generalizable, interpretable architecture for diagnosing complex, structured reasoning in any domain.
arxiv.titleZh: 让推理可见：结构化推理任务中面向自适应脚手架的配置感知诊断建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对自适应辅导系统只依据答案对错、无法刻画学习者多步推理过程的问题，构建诊断框架：从交互学习游戏的动作序列中计算五个可解释的策略维度（如系统纠错、随机猜测），由任务结构与行为模式估计协调负荷，并把推理划分为四种状态。对 234 名学生完成 42 道词法句法练习的 36,234 次交互分析发现，推理策略更多随情境变化而非稳定特质（组内相关系数 0.14），且学生易滞留于低效状态：高协调负荷导致的失败中，无干预时有 74.6% 会再次失败。早期预警模型仅用策略模式预测验证成功即达 AUC 0.826，加入序列上下文后升至 0.902，且不循环依赖当前错误计数。该框架为结构化推理诊断提供了可解释、可迁移的架构，但验证目前限于语言学习场景。
arxiv.reason: 教育场景下的学习者诊断，与 LLM 后训练及 Agent 无关
